summary: Sandbach United drew 1-1 with New Mills in their season opener, equalizing through what appeared to be an own goal in the second half after going in 0-1 down at the break. The Bach created several chances throughout the match, with efforts from Saul, Hatton, and Mitch Nolan, but couldn't find a winner on a scrappy afternoon. It was a competitive start to the campaign for the side, who will be looking to build on this opening result in their next fixture.
